Application Data.NAME: TechWave Cellular Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: TechWave Cellular Solutions specializes in the retail sale and repair of cellular phones and accessories. Our operations include providing a wide range of mobile devices, offering technical support, and performing on-site and in-store repairs. We also provide service plans and accessories to enhance customers' mobile experiences. Our commitment is to deliver excellent customer service and high-quality products while staying updated with the latest technology trends in the telecommunications industry.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a theft incident occurred at our location, resulting in the loss of several high-value cellular devices. The stolen items were valued at approximately $2,500. The claim was filed with local law enforcement, and we have since implemented enhanced security measures to prevent future occurrences. The claim is currently under review by our insurance provider.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: TL-30, UL Listed, Fire and Burglar Resistant
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance cameras and alarm system monitored by a central station, along with a nightly security patrol.
